spec.prompt: A simple village scene in daylight, seen from the front. In the centre foreground stands a large potter's wheel: a round, flat wooden turntable on a short central post, with a mound of wet grey clay sitting on top of the spinning head. A smiling adult sits on a low stool behind the wheel, leaning forward with both hands pressed onto the clay, which is rising into a vase shape. A small bowl of water sits on the ground beside the wheel. Behind them stands a small whitewashed village house with a thatched roof, a wooden door and a window. A few trees and a dirt path frame the background. No text, letters, numbers or signs anywhere in the scene.
